==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. Storm clouds rolled overhead and the air itself felt electrified. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.)

A giant flying glowing jellyfish fired bolts of lightning down in an effort to steal my Reality Warping Stone. (The Reality Warping Stone resembles a jagged diamond that is half pink and half yellow.)

I used my geomancy to redirect the lightning blast back at it with a funnel of magnetic stone, slaying the beast.
